items.title: Thomas Andrew Dorsey Interview, 1980-08-06
items.q: The interviewee discusses Brother Joe May in the context of vocal styles similar to Mahalia Jackson and Bessie Smith, stating 'he's good, but he didn't get around as much as Mahalia.' There is no evidence of personal interaction, collaboration, or direct acquaintance with Brother Joe May. The mentio

ctx.x: Did you tell us anything about him? Anything that comes back to mind? No, I couldn't, but he's a little bit beyond me. Yeah. All I could do, hey Joe, how you doing?
He's gone. He's gone. He's a bigger man. He might not have seen you. He was called Bad Eyes in the stuff. Did you know Louis? Yeah, Joe was great.
